facts.text: Mascouche station is the northern terminus of Exo's Mascouche commuter rail line into Montreal.
facts.evidence: Mascouche station is a commuter rail station operated by Exo in Mascouche, Quebec, a suburb north of Montreal. It is the northern terminus of the Mascouche line.

overview: Mascouche grew 9.6 percent between 2016 and 2021, from 46,692 to 51,183 residents, more than double the Quebec average. Its 19,981 occupied dwellings spread over 106.89 square kilometres, mixing established neighbourhoods with newer subdivisions and rural land.

A commuter rail line links residents to Montreal, while the CentrOparc business district keeps adding employers locally. For a local business, that means a steady stream of new households choosing providers for the first time, and growing competition from firms moving into the area.
